title: Please generate a summary of the closing balances at the end of each month
question: Please generate a summary of the closing balances at the end of each month for each customer transactions, show the monthly changes and monthly cumulative bank account balances. Ensure that even if a customer has no account activity in a given month, the balance for that month is still included in the output.

prediction.sql:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date) AS ym FROM customer_transactions
),
cust AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
grid AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, m.ym
  FROM cust c CROSS JOIN months m
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date) AS ym,
         SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END)
       - SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type IN ('purchase','withdrawal') THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) AS monthly_change
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date)
)
SELECT g.customer_id,
       g.ym AS month,
       COALESCE(m.monthly_change, 0) AS monthly_change,
       SUM(COALESCE(m.monthly_change, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY g.customer_id ORDER BY g.ym) AS cumulative_balance
FROM grid g
LEFT JOIN monthly m ON g.customer_id=m.customer_id AND g.ym=m.ym
ORDER BY g.customer_id, g.ym

persistent_recovery_advisory_draft.base_sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         substr(txn_date,1,7) AS month,
         SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount
                  WHEN txn_type IN ('withdrawal','purchase') THEN -txn_amount
                  ELSE 0 END) AS monthly_change
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, substr(txn_date,1,7)
),
cust_months AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, m.month
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions) c
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT substr(txn_date,1,7) AS month FROM customer_transactions) m
)
SELECT cm.customer_id,
       cm.month,
       COALESCE(mm.monthly_change,0) AS monthly_change,
       SUM(COALESCE(mm.monthly_change,0)) OVER (
         PARTITION BY cm.customer_id ORDER BY cm.month
         ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
       ) AS cumulative_balance
FROM cust_months cm
LEFT JOIN monthly mm
  ON cm.customer_id = mm.customer_id AND cm.month = mm.month
ORDER BY cm.customer_id, cm.month;
